admin.demoBanner: Operator console — demonstration mode: balances are credits, not money. Every action here is real and is recorded in the audit log.
admin.dashboard.title: Dashboard
admin.dashboard.description: Everything below is computed from the ledger and the player tables for the selected period. Each figure says what it measures.
admin.column.name: Name
admin.bets.title: Bets & activity
admin.bets.description: Every sportsbook ticket and casino round. Open sports tickets are settled here, leg by leg; casino rounds settle themselves on the server.
admin.transactions.title: Transactions
admin.reports.title: Reports
admin.reports.description: Volume and revenue over any period, with a breakdown per day or hour and CSV exports.
admin.responsible.title: Responsible gambling
admin.responsible.description: Active exclusions, cooling-off periods and limit activity across the population.
admin.responsible.noCasesDescription: Exclusions and cooling-off periods would appear here as players set them.
admin.settings.title: Settings
admin.settings.description: Only settings the platform actually enforces appear here. Changes are validated on the server and recorded in the audit log.
admin.settings.licenceMissing: No licence is configured, and none may be. This build must not be operated. Every gate below has to close first.
admin.rgCase.detail.limitIncreasePending: A limit increase is held in the cooling-off window
admin.rgCase.detail.limitReached: The player has reached a configured limit
admin.search.label: Search players, transactions and tickets
admin.period.label: Period
admin.dashboard.truncated: This period holds more entries than the charts can bucket in memory; the chart series are partial. Totals above are exact.
admin.dashboard.moreInReports: More detail, a daily breakdown and CSV exports are in Reports →
admin.metric.uniquePlayers: Unique players · signed in during period
admin.chart.registrationsSub: Count of players created, per bucket
admin.activity.title: Recent activity
admin.players.title: Players
admin.players.description: Search, filter and manage every player account. Open a player for their wallet, ledger, bets and activity.
admin.players.createDescription: Creates a player account that belongs to you. The username and password are generated and shown once — give them to the player.
admin.players.credentials: How will the player get access?
admin.players.mode.passwordBody: You choose a temporary password and hand it over. It stops working the moment the player sets their own at first sign-in.
admin.players.temporaryPasswordHint: Same strength rules as any password. It is never shown again.
admin.players.passwordNote: Give the player the temporary password you chose. They will be asked to replace it on first sign-in.
admin.players.restrictionsHint: Block wagering or withdrawals without suspending the account.
admin.players.editHint: A reason is required and goes in the audit log.
admin.players.verificationHint: A manual decision after reviewing documents elsewhere — no provider is connected.
admin.players.securityHint: You can replace a credential or end sessions — never read a password.
admin.players.resetLinkHint: Produces a one-time link the player uses to choose a new password. Shown to you once.
admin.players.accessControlHint: Takes effect immediately and ends the player’s sessions.
admin.players.suspendHint: A suspended player cannot sign in. Their balance and history are untouched.
admin.players.lockHint: A security lock — for suspected takeover or fraud review.
admin.players.error.invalidTransition: That change is not possible from the player’s current status
admin.validation.credentialModeInvalid: Choose how the player gets access
admin.wallet.title: Wallet & adjustments
admin.wallet.description: Withdrawals waiting for a decision, adjustments waiting for a second administrator, and the latest manual entries. To credit or debit a player, open them and use their Wallet tab.
admin.wallet.withdrawalsNote: The funds are already held. Approving records that you paid the player out of band; rejecting returns the funds to their balance.
admin.wallet.adjustBody: Every manual movement is a ledger entry with a reason, your name and an audit record. There is no other way to change a balance.
admin.wallet.externalReferenceHint: Shown to the player on the entry.
admin.wallet.reasonHint: Stays in the audit log; the player does not see it.
admin.wallet.needsApproval: At or above {threshold} TND this is queued for a second administrator instead of being applied.
admin.wallet.confirm: I confirm this entry for {username}: {amount} TND
admin.wallet.integrityOk: The balance equals the sum of all {entries} ledger entries.
admin.wallet.integrityBad: MISMATCH: balance {balance}, ledger sums to {ledger}. Investigate before any further adjustment.
admin.wallet.error.accountNotFundable: This account cannot receive entries (not yet activated, or closed)
admin.wallet.error.typeNotAllowed: That entry type is disabled in Settings
admin.wallet.error.overMax: Above the maximum adjustment set in Settings
admin.wallet.error.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own request
admin.bets.previewPending: Choose a result for every selection to see the payout.
admin.bets.confirmLabel: I confirm the results for {reference}. This pays out once and cannot be undone.
admin.bets.error.allLegsRequired: Choose a result for every selection
admin.reports.exportNote: Exports contain usernames and IDs — never e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses or internal reasons — and every export is recorded in the audit log.
admin.reports.breakdownNote: TND, gross per bucket. GGR = stakes − payouts.
admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.audit.description: An append-only record of administrative and security events. Nobody — including administrators — can edit or delete a row; the database refuses it.
admin.notifications.title: Notifications
admin.notifications.description: Alerts for new players, withdrawal requests, approvals, security events and large transactions.
admin.notifications.channelsNote: In-app is always on. Other channels plug in through the NotificationChannel interface and are not configured.
admin.settings.error.invalid: One or more values are out of range
admin.settings.env.note: Set in the deployment’s environment variables; change them there.
admin.settings.general.maintenanceMode.h: Blocks player sign-in, wagering and withdrawals. Administrators are unaffected.
admin.settings.players.requireVerificati: Players whose verification is not “verified” cannot place bets or play casino games.
admin.settings.wallet.minTransactionAmou: Applies to withdrawal requests and recorded deposits.
admin.settings.wallet.maxTransactionAmou: Applies to withdrawal requests and recorded deposits.
admin.settings.wallet.maxAdjustmentAmoun: A manual entry above this is refused outright.
admin.settings.wallet.adjustmentApproval: Manual entries at or above this amount wait for a different administrator. 0 disables it. Needs at least two administrators.
admin.settings.wallet.allowedAdjustmentT: Untick a type to stop administrators from posting it.
admin.settings.wallet.largeTransactionAl: Administrators are notified when a manual entry reaches this amount. 0 disables it.
Consecutive wrong passwords that trigger a temporary lock.
admin.settings.security.lockoutMinutes.h: How long the account refuses sign-in after the limit above.
admin.settings.security.passwordMinLengt: Can only be raised above the built-in minimum of 10.
admin.settings.security.passwordRequireS: Enforced when a password is set or changed.
admin.settings.responsible.limitIncrease: A player lowering a limit is protected at once; raising one waits this long.
admin.managers.title: Managers
admin.managers.description: The managers you created. Each one holds credit you issue, creates player accounts and sells them credit.
admin.managers.createDescription: The username and password are generated for you and shown once. Optionally give the manager their first credit now.
admin.managers.empty: No managers yet. Create the first one.
admin.managers.suspendHint: A suspended manager cannot sign in or sell credit. Their players and their balance are kept.
admin.managers.mustChange: Has not yet changed the generated password
admin.accounts.displayNameHint: A label for you to recognise the account. Defaults to the username.
admin.accounts.usernameHint: Leave empty to generate one (for example p-k7m2xq).
admin.accounts.initialCreditHint: Credit placed on the account as soon as it is created.
admin.accounts.generatedNote: The password is generated by the server, never stored in readable form and shown only once. The account holder must choose their own at first sign-in.
admin.accounts.createdBody: Hand over the username and password below. They will not be shown again.
admin.accounts.createdWithCredit: Account created with {amount} TND of credit. Hand over the details below — they will not be shown again.
admin.credentials.title: Sign-in details
admin.credentials.shownOnce: Shown once. If lost, generate a new password.
admin.credentials.resetHint: Replaces the current password right away, signs the account out everywhere and requires a new password at the next sign-in. The new one is shown once.
admin.credentials.confirmReset: I confirm: generate a new password for {username}
admin.credit.issueBody: Creates new credit on this manager’s balance. Every issue is recorded in the ledger and the audit log.
admin.credit.sellBody: Moves credit from your balance to this player. Both sides are recorded at once; you cannot sell more than you hold.
credit.error.insufficientBalance: You do not have enough credit for that.
credit.error.notAllowed: Your role cannot put credit on this account at creation.
admin.manager.homeDescription: Your credit, your players and what you have sold.
admin.withdrawals.title: Withdrawal requests
admin.withdrawals.description: Players asking to cash out their credit, oldest first.
admin.withdrawals.noteManager: Approve once you have paid the player. Their held credit then returns to your balance so you can sell it again. Reject to give the credit back to the player.
admin.withdrawals.noteSuperadmin: Approve once the player has been paid. If the player belongs to a manager, the credit returns to that manager's balance. Reject to give the credit back to the player.
admin.creditRequests.title: Credit requests
admin.creditRequests.description: Players asking you for credit, oldest first.
admin.creditRequests.note: Approving sells the credit to the player out of your balance ({balance}) — in red, a request is larger than what you hold. Rejecting tells the player no.
admin.creditRequests.approveDone: Approved — credit sold to the player
